User Request: Repeat the previous dashboard request but change the date range. Verify that the cache does not return results for the old date range.

Dashboard Components:
Title: Monthly Revenue
Type: chart
Description: Monthly revenue trend
Title: Top Selling Products
Type: table
Description: List of top selling products by revenue
Title: Customer Demographics
Type: pie_chart
Description: Distribution of customers by type
Title: Order Fulfillment Status
Type: bar_chart
Description: Status of orders (shipped, pending, etc.)
Title: Sales by Region
Type: map
Description: Sales distribution across different regions
Title: Employee Performance
Type: line_chart
Description: Sales performance by employee over time
Title: Inventory Levels
Type: gauge
Description: Current inventory levels for key products
Title: Shipping Costs
Type: area_chart
Description: Trends in shipping costs over the selected date range

sql_queries.title: Monthly Revenue
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) AS Month, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS Revenue FROM Orders o JOIN 'Order Details' od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID GROUP BY Month ORDER BY Month

sql_queries.title: Top Selling Products
sql_queries.description: List of top selling products by revenue
sql_queries.sql: SELECT p.ProductName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS Revenue FROM 'Order Details' od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID GROUP BY p.ProductID ORDER BY Revenue DESC LIMIT 10

sql_queries.title: Customer Demographics
sql_queries.sql: SELECT cd.CustomerDesc, COUNT(ccd.CustomerID) AS CustomerCount FROM CustomerCustomerDemo ccd JOIN CustomerDemographics cd ON ccd.CustomerTypeID = cd.CustomerTypeID GROUP BY cd.CustomerTypeID

sql_queries.title: Order Fulfillment Status
sql_queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN ShippedDate IS NOT NULL THEN 'Shipped' ELSE 'Pending' END AS Status, COUNT(OrderID) AS OrderCount FROM Orders GROUP BY Status

sql_queries.title: Sales by Region
sql_queries.sql: SELECT e.Region, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS Revenue FROM Orders o JOIN 'Order Details' od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Employees e ON o.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID GROUP BY e.Region

sql_queries.title: Employee Performance
sql_queries.description: Sales performance by employee over time
sql_queries.sql: SELECT e.EmployeeID, e.FirstName || ' ' || e.LastName AS EmployeeName, strftime('%Y-%m', o.OrderDate) AS Month, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS Revenue FROM Orders o JOIN 'Order Details' od ON o.OrderID = od.OrderID JOIN Employees e ON o.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID GROUP BY e.EmployeeID, Month ORDER BY e.EmployeeID, Month

sql_queries.title: Inventory Levels
sql_queries.description: Current inventory levels for key products
sql_queries.sql: SELECT ProductName, UnitsInStock FROM Products WHERE Discontinued = 'No' ORDER BY UnitsInStock DESC LIMIT 10

sql_queries.title: Shipping Costs
sql_queries.description: Trends in shipping costs over the selected date range
sql_queries.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', OrderDate) AS Month, SUM(Freight) AS TotalShippingCost FROM Orders GROUP BY Month ORDER BY Month
